rendered.subject: Collaboration Opportunity for an Instagram Post
rendered.body:
Hi Stumptown Coffee Roasters team,

We are a small Instagram content studio dedicated to bringing creative energy to your brand. We’d like to propose a collaborative Instagram post with you, built around the idea of honoring your Direct Trade relationships, paying quality premiums for your coffees, and creating multi-year commitments to your producers [P9]. Essentially, the post would showcase your commitment to quality and the impact of your partnerships, while also highlighting the unique customer experience you foster at your cafes. It would involve a visually appealing post that captures the essence of your mission, paired with a thoughtful message that invites your team to share their perspective and engage with your audience.

The post would be a collaborative effort, where we'd work together to craft a post that emphasizes your dedication to quality and the producers you support, while also celebrating the customer experience at your cafes [P5]. We'd aim to create a post that resonates with your audience and further reinforces your commitment to your producers.

Reply if you're interested in exploring this opportunity further.

The BrandPilot team
